facts.statement: The Solo Variant is a single-player mode and is out of scope by default.
facts.sourceSentence: Variant (p.2): Solo Variant — single-player mode. Out of scope by default.

facts.statement: The single-player variant is played exactly like the regular game.
facts.sourceSentence: Playing the single-player variant is the same as playing the regular game, the only difference is that you are scoring against yourself.

facts.statement: The only difference in the single-player variant is that the player scores against themselves rather than against an opponent.
facts.sourceSentence: Playing the single-player variant is the same as playing the regular game, the only difference is that you are scoring against yourself.

facts.statement: The first solo objective is to achieve a higher total score for each match.
facts.sourceSentence: To start, just try to get a higher total score for each match.

facts.statement: The next solo objective, after the first is mastered, is to finish each game of the match with a final score that is a multiple of 7.
facts.sourceSentence: After you've conquered that, attempt to get a multiple of 7 as your final score in each game during the match.

facts.statement: The multiples of 7 relevant to this objective are listed as 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, and 49.
facts.sourceSentence: As a reminder multiples of 7 are 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, and 49.

facts.statement: A perfect solo match requires scoring one of each of the listed multiples, in no particular order.
facts.sourceSentence: Therefore for a perfect solo match you would have to achieve a score of 1 of each in no particular order.

facts.statement: The final solo objective, after the multiple-of-7 objective is mastered, is to make one of each of the 7 scoring hands in each game during the match, in no particular order.
facts.sourceSentence: And after you've conquered that, attempt to get one of each of the 7 scoring hands in each game during the match in no particular order.
